comparison.objective: Select a reach rod and press a guarded reset button through a port; candidate adjusts and locks a robot-gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Long-tool selection, port insertion, and sustained axial pressing versus concentric driver/wrench countertorque and articulated verification.
comparison.success_condition: Requires rod penetration and a 5 mm button press held one second; candidate requires angle accuracy, seated hardware, repeated retained motion, and released clearance.
comparison.reason: Tool use is generic overlap only; the guarded reach-and-press ability is unrelated to preserving a threaded adjustment during jam-nut locking.
